caption: Discovery
description: Discovery information is published as an extension of an AI Catalog entry. It carries only the closed vocabularies that agent discovery indexes on: what a workload can do, the fields it applies to, the artifact formats it is published in, and how it is distributed. Everything else about the artifact — its name, description, version, publisher, and location — is carried by the catalog entry itself.
name: discovery

schema_version.caption: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Version of the OASF schema that this metadata conforms to. Consumers use it to select the vocabularies the remaining attributes are validated against.

skills.caption: Skills
skills.description: List of skills this workload is capable of performing.

domains.caption: Domains
domains.description: List of domains this workload operates in.

formats.caption: Formats
formats.description: List of specifications this workload's artifact conforms to.

distributions.caption: Distributions
distributions.description: List of forms this workload is distributed in. The locations themselves are carried by the catalog entry.
